description: Over the past several weeks I have heard from a great many people across Pickett, Scott, Fentress, and the rest of the district who have questions about news reports connecting our counties to a possible long-term nuclear waste repository. Because there has been a good deal of confusion about what has actually been proposed and what has not, I want to lay out plainly what is known, what remains unsettled, and what I have asked the Governor to do on behalf of the people I represent.BackgroundIn J
paid_for_by: Paid for by Kelly Keisling for State Representative, John Keisling, Treasurer
title: Understanding the Nuclear Waste Repository Proposal: A Briefing for the 38th District
